'''Von Doobba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ferronel]] on [[Cmaoli Di/Legends|Cmaoli Di]]. He was a representative to the planetary council, and a fervent [[Pinacism|Pinacist]]. After urging his colleagues to withdraw from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the subsequent decision to reject his plea by the council, Doobba resigned and prepared to leave the planet with his most ardent supporters.
